## Critique
- claim-1: Correctly grounds the Schur-basis description of the quotient.
- claim-2: Correctly grounds the parameter formulas and lower-adjoined family.
- claim-3: Correctly grounds the conjugation involution and transport of rectangle ideals.
- claim-4: The proof is mathematically complete. Conjugation transports the Schur interval basis, the positive-degree ideal, and hence \(A_+J\). The displayed partition formula gives an exact bijection from the lower-adjoined family to the right-adjoined family. The original and swapped bigrassmannian admissibility inequalities are verified. Although the displayed quotient map is oriented \(\Lambda/I_{q,r}\to\Lambda/I_{r,q}\), its inverse is the same involution, yielding the requested orientation as well. Thus the requested standalone parameter-conjugation target is established; no minimality conclusion is asserted.
